source: PLACEHOLDER VALUES - NOT COLLECTED FROM THE MARKET. Copied from the indicative demo numbers in scripts/demo_data.py so the demo has something to show. Replace every value marked "placeholder": true with rates collected locally (see ml/pricing/ASSUMPTIONS.md, section 'Replacing placeholders'), then set is_placeholder to false, update 'updated' and describe the real source here.

scrap._unit: INR per kg paid by a local kabadiwala (low = typical floor, high = typical best rate)

paper.notes: Newspaper, books, notebooks. Newspaper usually fetches the upper end.

cardboard.notes: Dry, flattened cartons. Wet or oily board is often refused.

plastic.notes: Wide range: clean PET bottles sit at the top, mixed or soft plastic at the bottom.

metal.notes: Blended iron/steel range. Aluminium and copper are worth several times more; split them when real rates are collected.

glass.notes: Many kabadiwalas take glass for little or nothing; bottles may be bought per piece instead.

not_priced_per_kg.ewaste: Priced per item by POST /ewaste/quote (see the 'ewaste' section), not per kg.
not_priced_per_kg.battery: Hazardous. Always routed to an authorised drop-off point; EcoLink never quotes a buying price for batteries.

ewaste._unit: INR. base_low/base_high = resale range of a like-new working unit; depreciated by age and condition.

other.notes: Fallback for any item type not listed above.

rules._note: Mirrors constants in backend/ecolink/core/pricing.py (tests fail if they drift).
